HOW IT WORKS
1
Open the link above
It works on a phone, a tablet or a computer. You will need a free Canva account — signing up takes a minute and costs nothing.
2
Choose “Use template”
Canva makes a private copy just for you. The original stays untouched, so nothing you do here can go wrong.
3
Replace the text with your own
Click any text to edit it. Colours, fonts and sizes can all be changed. Photo areas are swapped by clicking the image and choosing your own.
4
Download and print
Share → Download → PDF Print. Choose crop marks and bleed if your printer asks for them.

YOUR SHOP NAME
Printing your cards
A few notes that make the difference between a card that looks printed and one that looks made.
SIZE
5 × 7 inches
The standard invitation size. Envelopes labelled A7 fit it exactly.
RESOLUTION
300 DPI
Print quality. Do not scale the file up — it is already at the right resolution.
PAPER
250–300 g/m² card
Matte or lightly textured card looks closest to letterpress. Glossy photo paper does not suit these designs.
AT HOME
Print “actual size”
Turn off “fit to page” — it shrinks the design and leaves a white margin.
AT A PRINT SHOP
Send the PDF
Ask for 5 × 7 inches on card, trimmed. Most shops will ask for bleed; Canva adds it in the download dialog.
DIGITAL ONLY
Download as PNG
For sending by message or e-mail. Choose PNG rather than PDF for phones.
